editorial:
You know that feeling when a movie makes you laugh out loud at something totally ridiculous? Strays is exactly that kind of movie. It follows Reggie, a sweet but naive dog who gets dumped by his terrible owner Doug. Reggie teams up with Bug, a street-smart stray who teaches him that owners aren't always good guys. Together with a couple of other dog friends, they set off on a wild road trip to get back at Doug. The whole thing is told from the dogs' point of view, which makes every scene feel fresh and funny. The humor is crude and silly, but it works because the dogs are so lovable.

The voice acting is a big highlight, especially Will Ferrell as Reggie and Jamie Foxx as Bug. Their back-and-forth banter keeps things moving. The pacing is quick, and there are plenty of laugh-out-loud moments. On the downside, some jokes go a little too far and the story is pretty simple. If you enjoy raunchy comedies and don't mind talking animals, you'll have a great time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Reggie and his friends finally reach Doug's house. Reggie confronts Doug and bites off his penis as revenge for years of abuse and neglect. Doug is left screaming on the floor while his friends watch. Reggie then walks away and finds a loving new family who adopts him. The movie ends with Reggie happy and free, finally surrounded by people who actually care about him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raunchy comedies and talking animal movies.
